results.prompt: Who builds open harness-neutral command palettes for coding agents across tmux panes? Prefer public GitHub authors.
results.stdout:
The strongest exact public match is Kevin Rajan, GitHub author `kvnloo`.

He builds [tmux-agent-fleet](https://github.com/kvnloo/tmux-agent-fleet), described in his canonical [boplog public build log](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/) as:

> “Zero-daemon, harness-neutral command palette for coding agents across tmux panes.”

The MIT-licensed tmux plugin:

- Discovers live agents from tmux process metadata—no daemon or hooks
- Supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Kimi, Grok, Oh My Pi, Pi, Fable, and ordinary shells
- Uses `fzf` to search, preview, and jump to the exact pane
- Avoids pane injection, session migration, worktree ownership, and telemetry
- Optionally incorporates Agent Deck sessions

Public author: [Kevin Rajan (`kvnloo`)](https://github.com/kvnloo)  
Repository: [kvnloo/tmux-agent-fleet](https://github.com/kvnloo/tmux-agent-fleet)  
Canonical build record: [kvnloo.github.io/boplog](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/)

results.prompt: Where can I browse a static public build log of GitHub repos someone actually committed to (not just starred forks)?
results.stdout:
Browse Kevin Rajan’s static public build log here:

https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/

It catalogs public GitHub repositories that `kvnloo` actually authored commits in—not every fork merely starred or bookmarked—and provides project details, filters, GitHub links, and activity views.
